resources.string: Fortuna tracks what you own and what you owe, and how it changes over time. Everything stays on this phone.
There is no account and nothing is sent anywhere. A PIN protects your data, and a recovery phrase gets you back in if you forget the PIN.
If you lose both your PIN and your recovery phrase, nobody can recover your data.
Use six digits or more. You will enter it each time you open Fortuna.
To make sure it is the one you meant.
A PIN needs at least six digits.
The two PINs were different. Choose your PIN again.
Write these twelve words down on paper, in order, and keep them somewhere safe. They are the only way back in if you forget your PIN. This is the only time they are shown.
You can switch to another app and come back to these same words. But if Fortuna is closed before setup finishes, nothing is kept: you will start again and get new words.
Enter these words from what you wrote down.
Those words do not match. Look at the phrase again and check what you wrote.
Totals and charts are shown in this currency. Accounts in other currencies are converted to it.
This phone can no longer open your data with the PIN. Your recovery phrase will get you back in.
Your dashboard arrives in the next version.
